index_space.fact: a window-scoped snapshot walk (xid != 0) walks the caller's window FIRST ('Walk the caller's window FIRST', native.rs:1393), so a snapshot's element index is an address in that window-first order; collect_visited(conn, pid) (xid 0, native.rs:950) walks the whole application in the application's own window order
index_space.consequence: the same index in a pid-wide walk names the first window's node for a token of any later window (live), and the next window's node for a token of a closed window. Observed: both windows' checkbox index 2, Note index 6, Scroll bar index 10 (shakedown handles)
